Documentation of removals pipeline and join to arrests/detention stays.

```{r}

library(tidyverse)

stays <- arrow::read_parquet(here::here("data/detention-stays-latest.parquet"))
removals <- arrow::read_parquet(here::here("data/removals-latest.parquet"))
joined <- arrow::read_parquet(here::here("data/joined-arrests-detention-stays-latest.parquet"))

```

What is structure of removals data currently in stays dataset (derived from detention stints)?

```{r}

stays <- stays |>
  group_by(unique_identifier) |>
  mutate(n_departed_date = n_distinct(departed_date),
         n_stays = n_distinct(stay_ID),
         ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(bookout_to_deport_days = difftime(departed_date, as.Date(stay_book_out_date_time), units = "days"))


```

```{r}

hist(stays$n_departed_date)
hist(stays$n_stays)
hist(as.numeric(stays$bookout_to_deport_days))
mean(stays$bookout_to_deport_days, na.rm=TRUE)
median(stays$bookout_to_deport_days, na.rm=TRUE)

stays |> count(n_departed_date, n_stays)

sum(stays$n_departed_date > 1)

```

```{r}

removals_via_stays <- stays |>
  filter(stay_release_reason %in% c("Removed", "Voluntary departure", "Voluntary Return", "Title 42 Return")) |>
  arrange(unique_identifier) |>
  select(stay_ID, stay_book_in_date_time, stay_book_out_date_time, departed_date, bookout_to_deport_days, departure_country, stay_release_reason, n_departed_date, n_stays)

```
